arguments.query_text: Check the foliage Substrate override and current map actor count without changing anything.
arguments.python_script:
import unreal, json
s=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.UnrealEditorSubsystem)
a=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
m=unreal.load_asset('/Game/Generated_Materials/M_Mall_pachira_aquatica_01_leaves')
n=[x for x in m.get_editor_property('Expressions') if x.get_class().get_name()=='MaterialExpressionSubstrateShadingModels']
unreal.log(json.dumps({'world':s.get_editor_world().get_path_name(),'actor_count':len(a.get_all_level_actors()),'leaf_override':str(n[0].get_editor_property('ShadingModelOverride')) if n else None}))
